title: 在 Seedance 2.0 里用“视频规格”硬性约束：严格总时长 15 秒、16:9 横屏、24fps，并指定三个干净镜头来控制节奏与剪辑结构
content:
在 Seedance 2.0 里用“视频规格”硬性约束：严格总时长 15 秒、16:9 横屏、24fps，并指定三个干净镜头来控制节奏与剪辑结构  
用“反转式喜剧（Comedy Twist）”作为类型标签，并明确前半段宏大庄重、后半段突然尴尬现实喜剧，要求反转必须突然且不能提前暗示  
用分镜时间码（如 00:00-00:03/00:03-00:07/00:07-00:10/00:10-00:12）逐镜头写清机位（超低机位仰拍/侧面跟拍/固定侧面全景/正面机位）、动作、音效与字幕，提升可控性  
加入“关键连续性”约束（道具位置与运动、车辆只经过不接触、动作空间连续、人物/道具不得瞬移）来减少穿帮和跳变  
用参考图锁定角色一致性：明确“严格保持参考图片中的脸部、发型、服装、体型一致，全程不得换脸或改变造型”  
在提示词里加入负面约束清单（不受伤不流血、不出现事故、不变更道具形态、避免肢体扭曲/多余手脚/关节反向、避免动漫/游戏CG/塑料皮肤/AI假脸）来提升写实与安全性  
为表演指定可验证的表情变化序列（得意 → 疑惑 → 惊恐 → 呆滞）并要求镜头保留反应时长（至少约 1 秒）以保证喜剧点落地  
用声音反差强化反转：货车经过瞬间立即切断恢宏音乐并转为安静环境声，增强“突然”效果

en.content:
Use “video specifications” in Seedance 2.0 as hard constraints: strictly total duration 15 seconds, 16:9 landscape, 24fps, and specify three clean shots to control pacing and editing structure  
Use “Comedy Twist” as the genre tag, and clearly define the first half as grand and solemn, and the second half as suddenly awkward real-world comedy, requiring the twist to happen abruptly with no prior hint  
Use storyboard timecodes (e.g. 00:00-00:03 / 00:03-00:07 / 00:07-00:10 / 00:10-00:12) to clearly specify each shot’s camera angle (extreme low-angle upward shot / side tracking shot / fixed side wide shot / frontal shot), action, sound effects, and subtitles to improve controllability  
Add “key continuity” constraints (prop position and movement, vehicles only pass by without contact, continuous action space, no instant teleportation of characters/props) to reduce glitches and jump cuts  
Lock character consistency with a reference image: explicitly state “strictly maintain the face, hairstyle, clothing, and body type from the reference image throughout; no face-swapping or styling changes allowed”  
Add a negative constraint list in the prompt (no injury, no blood, no accidents, no changes to prop form, avoid limb distortion / extra hands or feet / reversed joints, avoid anime / game CG / plastic skin / fake AI face) to improve realism and safety  
Specify a verifiable sequence of performance expressions (smug → confused → terrified → stunned) and require the shot to preserve reaction time (at least about 1 second) to ensure the comedy beat lands  
Use sound contrast to strengthen the twist: the moment the truck passes, immediately cut off the grand music and switch to quiet ambient sound to enhance the “sudden” effect

--- QUOTED TWEET ---
Kind of interesting, this sword immortal just arrived and isn’t familiar with things yet

Generate video: Comedy Twist | A xianxia master’s first encounter with urban side wind

Seedance 2.0 is very well suited for this kind of absurd idea.

One second she’s a cool, aloof sword immortal cruising on her sword; the next, she gets brutally humbled by modern city traffic.

prompt 👇

【Video Specifications】

Duration: 10 seconds  
Aspect ratio: 16:9 landscape  
Genre: Comedy Twist  
Visual style: live-action, cinematic realism, natural skin texture, real urban environment  

【Core Contrast】  
The first half should create a grand, solemn, oppressive xianxia blockbuster atmosphere.  
The second half should suddenly shift into a flustered, quiet, awkward real-world comedy.  
The twist must happen abruptly, with no prior hint. The overall absurdity should still remain logically clear, keeping the tone light and harmless.

【Scene】

A sunny daytime city arterial road.

The road includes two-way motor vehicle lanes, a roadside non-motorized lane, and a sidewalk.

A large pile of loose discarded cardboard boxes is stacked beside the sidewalk. The boxes vary in size and can scatter outward when the character falls into them, creating an exaggerated but safe comedic effect.

【Character】

Sword Immortal Sister: @Image 1

Strictly keep the character consistent with the reference image in face, hairstyle, clothing, body type, and character traits; no face-swapping or styling changes throughout.

【Key Continuity】

The silver longsword remains suspended beneath Sword Immortal Sister’s feet throughout the first half.

The blue truck only passes by in the adjacent motor vehicle lane and must not touch or hit any character, the longsword, or the bicycle.

Sword Immortal Sister falling into the cardboard box pile is a safe, exaggerated comedic performance; no injury, blood, pain, or real traffic accident should appear.

All actions must remain spatially continuous; characters and props must not teleport.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[00:00-00:03]

【Shot 1: Blockbuster xianxia entrance】

Extreme low-angle upward shot, camera quickly tracking backward.

Sword Immortal Sister rides a floating silver longsword, streaking across the air about two meters above the city road.

She clasps her hands behind her back, chin slightly raised, gaze cold, expression proud, as if looking down on the mortal world.

Her long hair and skirt are blown backward by the oncoming airflow, with stable, elegant, and imposing movement.

Sunlight creates sharp reflections on the silver blade, and the sword leaves a faint silver trail of sword energy as it cuts through the air.

Sound effects: grand xianxia music, whooshing wind, deep sword hum.

Opening subtitle:

“When a sword immortal first enters the modern traffic system”

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[00:03-00:07]

【Shot 2: One compliment and she’s completely floating】

Cut to a side tracking shot along the non-motorized lane.

Bicycle Sister rides into frame on a bicycle, looks up at Sword Immortal Sister in the air, instantly widens her eyes, then excitedly pedals faster to catch up.

Bicycle Sister shouts with genuine admiration:

“Damn! Sis, you’re way too cool!”

Cut to a close-up of Sword Immortal Sister’s face.

After hearing the praise, the corners of her previously indifferent mouth briefly lift, then she immediately forces them back down.

She pretends to be calm while lifting a hand to brush her hair, but her eyes secretly glance downward at Bicycle Sister, clearly already feeling smug.

The silver longsword beneath her seems to cooperate with its owner’s flair, drawing two smooth S-shaped curves in the air.

Sound effects: the xianxia music continues, with a subtle smug “hmph-hmph” and sparkling sound effects added.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[00:07-00:10]

【Shot 3: Reality suddenly strikes】

Cut to a fixed side wide shot.

Sword Immortal Sister closes her eyes and slightly lifts her chin, enjoying Bicycle Sister’s admiration.

A huge blue truck suddenly speeds past in the adjacent motor vehicle lane.

The truck does not hit any character, but as it passes, it creates an extremely exaggerated and powerful side wind.

Sword Immortal Sister’s hair, skirt, and facial expression are all blown into disarray by the wind.

The smug smile on her face vanishes instantly, and her eyes fly open wide, pupils shaking.

The silver longsword beneath her begins to wobble violently left and right.

She tries to regain her masterful pose, but her hands flail awkwardly in the air twice.

Then her body, like a sheet of paper blown away by the wind, drifts sideways along with the sword toward the cardboard box pile by the roadside.

Sound effects: low truck horn, fierce side wind.

The instant the truck passes, the grand xianxia music stops immediately.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[00:10-00:12]

【Shot 4: The fairy falls into the mortal world】

Quick cut to a frontal shot of the cardboard box pile.

Sword Immortal Sister crashes headfirst into the pile of discarded boxes in an exaggerated but safe pose.

The boxes explode outward instantly.

A large box gets stuck over her upper body, and two smaller boxes slowly land on her head and shoulder.

The silver longsword spins out of control in the air twice, the sword energy completely disappears, and then it falls beside her like an ordinary metal plank.

“Clang!”

The scene suddenly becomes completely silent.

Only the slow rolling of the cardboard boxes remains, along with a lonely crow cawing in the distance.

【Performance Focus】

In the first half, Sword Immortal Sister must be extremely aloof, elegant, and confident, with the real oppressive presence of a xianxia master.

When the side wind hits, her expression must clearly go through four stages:

smug → confused → terrified → stunned

In the first half, Bicycle Sister must be genuinely admiring; after seeing Sword Immortal Sister fall, she should first freeze in shock, and only then try hard to suppress laughter.

Bicycle Sister must not appear mocking or gleeful from the start.

【Shot Rhythm】

The first three seconds should quickly establish a blockbuster xianxia feel.

After Bicycle Sister’s compliment, keep at least about one second of Sword Immortal Sister’s facial reaction so the audience can clearly see her secretly feeling smug.

Before the truck appears, there must be no advance hint through sound, shadows, camera movement, or character gaze.

After the truck passes, cut off the xianxia music immediately and use sudden silence to heighten the comedic contrast.

After the final line, freeze the frame immediately; do not drag it out or add extra plot.

【Avoid】

Do not let the blue truck hit any character, bicycle, or the longsword.

Do not show serious traffic accidents, injury, blood, pain, or dangerous realistic imagery.

Do not change the character’s face, hairstyle, clothing, body type, or identity traits.

Do not let the silver longsword turn into a skateboard, broom, surfboard, or any other object.

Do not show clipping through objects, limb distortion, abnormal fingers, extra hands or feet, or reversed joints.

Do not let characters or props teleport within the same shot.

Do not use anime character textures, game CG textures, plastic skin, or obviously fake AI faces.

Do not shoot the twist like a disaster film or a thriller.

Do not add explosions, rollovers, collisions, rear-end crashes, or crowd panic.

Keep the overall tone safe, light, absurd, and harmless as a comedy twist.
---

En Seedance 2.0, usa “especificaciones de video” como restricción estricta: duración total exacta de 15 segundos, formato 16:9 horizontal, 24 fps, y especifica tres planos limpios para controlar el ritmo y la estructura de edición.  
Usa “comedia con giro” (Comedy Twist) como etiqueta de género, y deja claro que la primera mitad debe ser grandiosa y solemne, mientras que la segunda mitad debe convertirse de repente en una comedia de vergüenza cotidiana; el giro debe ser súbito y no puede insinuarse antes.  
Con timecodes de storyboard (por ejemplo, 00:00-00:03 / 00:03-00:07 / 00:07-00:10 / 00:10-00:12), escribe con claridad en cada plano la posición de cámara (ángulo contrapicado desde muy bajo / seguimiento lateral / plano general lateral fijo / cámara frontal), la acción, los efectos de sonido y los subtítulos, para aumentar el control.  
Añade restricciones de “continuidad clave” (posición y movimiento de los props, los vehículos solo pasan sin tocar, continuidad del espacio de acción, personajes/props no pueden teletransportarse) para reducir errores de continuidad y saltos.  
Usa una imagen de referencia para fijar la consistencia del personaje: deja explícito “mantener estrictamente iguales el rostro, el peinado, la ropa y la complexión de la imagen de referencia; no se permite cambiar de cara ni de estilo en ningún momento”.  
Incluye en el prompt una lista de restricciones negativas (sin heridas ni sangre, sin accidentes, sin cambiar la forma de los props, evitar deformaciones de extremidades/manos o pies extra/articulaciones al revés, evitar estilo anime/CG de videojuego/piel plástica/cara falsa de IA) para mejorar el realismo y la seguridad.  
Especifica una secuencia verificable de cambios de expresión para la actuación (presumida → confundida → aterrada → atónita) y exige que el plano conserve el tiempo de reacción (al menos aprox. 1 segundo) para que el remate cómico funcione.  
Refuerza el giro con contraste sonoro: en el instante en que pasa el camión, corta de inmediato la música épica y cámbiala a sonido ambiente silencioso, para potenciar el efecto de “súbito”.

【Especificaciones de video】

Duración: 10 segundos  
Formato: 16:9 horizontal  
Tipo: comedia con giro (Comedy Twist)  
Textura visual: acción real, realismo cinematográfico, textura de piel natural, entorno urbano realista

La primera mitad debe crear una atmósfera de gran producción xianxia, majestuosa, solemne y opresiva.  
La segunda mitad debe pasar de repente a una comedia realista de vergüenza, torpeza y silencio.  
El giro debe ocurrir de forma súbita, sin insinuarse antes; en conjunto debe ser absurdo pero lógicamente claro, manteniendo un tono ligero y sin daño.

【Escena】

Una avenida principal de la ciudad en un día soleado.

La vía incluye carriles para vehículos en ambos sentidos, un carril para bicicletas junto a la calzada y una acera.

Junto a la acera hay un gran montón de cajas de cartón viejas y sueltas, de tamaños variados, que pueden dispersarse hacia los lados cuando el personaje cae, creando un efecto cómico exagerado pero seguro.

【Personaje】

Hermana espadachina inmortal: @imagen1

Mantener estrictamente iguales al personaje y a la imagen de referencia en rostro, peinado, ropa, complexión y rasgos; no se permite cambiar de cara ni de estilo en ningún momento.

【Continuidad clave】

La espada larga plateada debe permanecer suspendida bajo los pies de la espadachina inmortal durante la primera mitad.

El gran camión azul solo debe pasar por el carril de vehículos lateral; no debe tocar ni chocar con ningún personaje, espada ni bicicleta.

La caída de la espadachina inmortal en la pila de cajas debe ser una actuación cómica segura y exagerada; no debe haber heridas, sangre, dolor ni un accidente de tráfico real.

Todos los movimientos deben mantener continuidad espacial; los personajes y props no pueden teletransportarse.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[00:00-00:03]

【Plano 1: entrada digna de una superproducción xianxia】

Ángulo contrapicado desde muy abajo, con la cámara siguiendo rápidamente hacia atrás.

La espadachina inmortal vuela a gran velocidad sobre la carretera urbana, a unos dos metros del suelo, de pie sobre una espada larga plateada suspendida.

Lleva las manos a la espalda, el mentón ligeramente elevado, la mirada fría y la expresión altiva, como si contemplara el mundo mortal desde arriba.

El cabello largo y el dobladillo de la falda son empujados hacia atrás por el viento frontal; el movimiento es estable, elegante y lleno de presión.

La luz del sol crea reflejos intensos sobre la superficie plateada de la espada; al cortar el aire, deja una tenue estela de energía de espada plateada.

Efectos de sonido: música xianxia majestuosa, silbido del aire al romperse, zumbido grave de la espada.

Subtítulo de apertura:

“Cuando el espadachín inmortal entra por primera vez en el sistema de tráfico moderno”

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[00:03-00:07]

【Plano 2: un halago exagerado la hace perder totalmente la compostura】

Corte a un seguimiento lateral en el carril para bicicletas.

La chica de la bici entra en cuadro montando su bicicleta; al ver a la espadachina inmortal en el aire, abre los ojos de par en par y luego acelera con entusiasmo para seguirla pedaleando.

La chica de la bici grita con admiración sincera:

“¡Madre mía! ¡Hermana, estás demasiado genial!”

Corte a un primer plano del rostro de la espadachina inmortal.

Tras escuchar el elogio, la comisura de sus labios, antes fría, se eleva brevemente y enseguida vuelve a bajarla a la fuerza.

Finge calma mientras se lleva una mano al cabello, pero sus ojos miran de reojo hacia abajo a la chica de la bici; claramente ya está empezando a presumir.

La espada larga plateada bajo sus pies parece acompañar la exhibición de su dueña, trazando en el aire dos suaves curvas en forma de S.

Efectos de sonido: la música xianxia continúa, con un leve sonido de satisfacción tipo “hm hm” y efectos brillantes.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[00:07-00:10]

【Plano 3: el mundo real entra de golpe】

Corte a un plano general lateral fijo.

La espadachina inmortal, con los ojos cerrados y el mentón ligeramente levantado, está disfrutando de la admiración de la chica de la bici.

Un enorme camión azul pasa de repente a gran velocidad por el carril de vehículos lateral.

El camión no golpea a ningún personaje, pero al pasar genera una corriente lateral extremadamente exagerada y fuerte.

El cabello, la falda y la expresión facial de la espadachina inmortal se desordenan al mismo tiempo por el viento.

Su sonrisa de orgullo desaparece al instante; abre mucho los ojos, con las pupilas temblando.

La espada larga plateada bajo sus pies empieza a balancearse violentamente de izquierda a derecha.

Intenta recuperar la pose de experta, pero sus manos hacen dos movimientos torpes en el aire, como buscando apoyo.

Después, su cuerpo, como una hoja de papel arrastrada por el viento, se desplaza lateralmente junto con la espada hacia la pila de cajas al borde de la calle.

Efectos de sonido: bocina grave del camión, fuerte viento lateral.

En el instante en que pasa el camión, la música xianxia se detiene de inmediato.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[00:10-00:12]

【Plano 4: la inmortal cae al mundo mortal】

Corte rápido a una cámara frontal de la pila de cajas.

La espadachina inmortal cae de forma exagerada pero segura de cabeza dentro del montón de cajas viejas.

Dans Seedance 2.0, utilisez des « spécifications vidéo » comme contraintes strictes : durée totale de 15 secondes, format horizontal 16:9, 24 fps, et trois plans propres clairement définis pour contrôler le rythme et la structure du montage.  
Utilisez « Comedy Twist » comme étiquette de genre, et précisez clairement qu’en première moitié l’ambiance est grandiose et solennelle, tandis qu’en seconde moitié elle bascule soudainement vers une comédie du quotidien gênante ; exigez que le retournement soit brutal et sans aucun indice préalable.  
Utilisez des timecodes de storyboard (par ex. 00:00-00:03 / 00:03-00:07 / 00:07-00:10 / 00:10-00:12) pour détailler plan par plan le cadrage (contre-plongée très basse / travelling latéral / plan large latéral fixe / caméra frontale), les actions, les effets sonores et les sous-titres, afin d’améliorer la contrôlabilité.  
Ajoutez des contraintes de « continuité clé » (position et mouvement des accessoires, les véhicules ne font que passer sans contact, continuité de l’espace d’action, personnages/objets ne doivent pas se téléporter) pour réduire les erreurs de raccord et les sauts visuels.  
Verrouillez la cohérence du personnage avec une image de référence : précisez « conserver strictement la cohérence du visage, de la coiffure, des vêtements et de la morphologie de l’image de référence, sans changement de visage ni de style du début à la fin ».  
Ajoutez dans le prompt une liste de contraintes négatives (pas de blessure, pas de sang, pas d’accident, pas de changement de forme des accessoires, éviter les membres déformés / doigts ou bras en trop / articulations inversées, éviter le style anime / CG de jeu vidéo / peau plastique / faux visage IA) pour renforcer le réalisme et la sécurité.  
Spécifiez une séquence d’expressions vérifiable pour le jeu d’acteur (fier → perplexe → terrifié → figé) et demandez au plan de conserver le temps de réaction (au moins environ 1 seconde) afin de garantir l’impact comique.  
Renforcez le retournement par un contraste sonore : au moment où le camion passe, coupez immédiatement la musique grandiose et passez à un son d’ambiance silencieux, afin d’accentuer l’effet de « soudaineté ».

No Seedance 2.0, use “video specifications” as hard constraints: strictly total duration of 15 seconds, 16:9 landscape, 24fps, and specify three clean shots to control pacing and editing structure  
Use “Comedy Twist” as the genre tag, and clearly define the first half as grand and solemn, and the second half as suddenly awkward real-world comedy, requiring the twist to happen abruptly with no prior hint  
Use shot-by-shot timecodes (e.g. 00:00-00:03/00:03-00:07/00:07-00:10/00:10-00:12) to clearly write out camera angle (ultra-low-angle upward shot/side tracking shot/fixed side wide shot/front-facing shot), action, sound effects, and subtitles, improving controllability  
Add “key continuity” constraints (prop position and movement, vehicles only pass by without contact, continuous action space, characters/props must not teleport) to reduce continuity errors and jump cuts  
Use reference images to lock character consistency: explicitly state “strictly keep the face, hairstyle, clothing, and body type consistent with the reference image; no face swapping or style changes throughout”  
Add a negative constraint list in the prompt (no injury, no blood, no accidents, no changes to prop shape, avoid limb distortion/extra hands or feet/reversed joints, avoid anime/game CG/plastic skin/obvious AI fake faces) to improve realism and safety  
Specify a verifiable expression progression for the performance (proud → confused → terrified → blank) and require the shot to hold the reaction long enough (at least about 1 second) to ensure the comedy beat lands

Generate video: Comedy Twist | A xianxia master’s first encounter with urban side wind

One second she’s a cool, aloof sword immortal cruising on her sword; the next, she gets brutally humbled by modern city traffic.

prompt 👇

【Video Specifications】

Duration: 10 seconds
Aspect ratio: 16:9 landscape
Genre: Comedy Twist
Visual style: live-action, cinematic realism, natural skin texture, real urban environment
【Core Contrast】
The first half should create a grand, solemn, oppressive xianxia blockbuster atmosphere.
The second half should suddenly shift into a flustered, quiet, awkward real-world comedy.
The twist must happen suddenly, with no prior hint; the overall tone should be absurd but logically clear, maintaining a light, harmless comedic atmosphere.

【Scene】

A sunny daytime city arterial road.

The road includes two-way motor vehicle lanes, a roadside non-motorized lane, and a sidewalk.

Next to the sidewalk is a large pile of loose discarded cardboard boxes, varying in size, able to scatter outward when the character falls into them, creating an exaggerated but safe comedic effect.

【Character】

Sword Immortal Sister: @image1

Strictly keep the character consistent with the reference image in face, hairstyle, clothing, body type, and character traits; no face swapping or style changes throughout.

【Key Continuity】

The silver longsword remains floating beneath Sword Immortal Sister’s feet throughout the first half.

The blue truck only passes by in the adjacent motor vehicle lane and must not touch or hit any character, the longsword, or the bicycle.

Sword Immortal Sister falling into the cardboard box pile is a safe, exaggerated comedic performance; no injury, blood, pain, or real traffic accident should appear.

All actions must remain spatially continuous; characters and props must not teleport.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[00:00-00:03]

【Shot 1: Blockbuster xianxia entrance】

Ultra-low-angle upward shot, camera quickly tracking backward.

Sword Immortal Sister rides a floating silver longsword, streaking rapidly about two meters above the city road.

She keeps both hands behind her back, chin slightly raised, eyes cold, expression proud, as if looking down on the mortal world.

Her long hair and skirt are blown backward by the oncoming airflow, with stable, elegant, and oppressive movement.

Sunlight creates sharp reflections on the silver sword surface, and the longsword leaves a faint silver sword-energy trail as it cuts through the air.

Sound effects: grand xianxia music, whooshing wind, deep sword hum.

Opening subtitle:

“When a sword immortal first enters the modern traffic system”

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[00:03-00:07]

【Shot 2: One compliment and she’s completely floating】

Cut to a side tracking shot along the non-motorized lane.

The bicycle girl rides into frame, looks up at the sword immortal in the air, instantly widens her eyes, then excitedly pedals faster to catch up.

The bicycle girl shouts with genuine admiration:

“Damn! Sis, you’re way too cool!”

Cut to a close-up of Sword Immortal Sister’s face.

After hearing the praise, the corners of her previously indifferent mouth briefly lift, then she immediately forces them back down.

She pretends to stay calm while lifting a hand to brush her hair, but her eyes secretly glance downward at the bicycle girl, clearly already feeling smug.

The silver longsword beneath her seems to cooperate with its owner’s showmanship, drawing two smooth S-shaped curves in the air.

Sound effects: xianxia music continues, with a subtle smug “hmph” and sparkling sound effects added.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[00:07-00:10]

【Shot 3: Reality suddenly strikes】

Cut to a fixed side wide shot.

Sword Immortal Sister closes her eyes and slightly lifts her chin, enjoying the bicycle girl’s admiration.

A huge blue truck suddenly speeds past in the adjacent motor vehicle lane.

The truck does not hit any character, but as it passes, it creates an extremely exaggerated and powerful side wind.

Sword Immortal Sister’s hair, skirt, and facial expression are all blown into disarray by the wind.

Her smug smile vanishes instantly, and her eyes fly open wide, pupils shaking.

The silver longsword beneath her begins to sway violently left and right.

She tries to regain her masterful composure, but her hands flail awkwardly in the air twice.

Then her body, like a sheet of paper blown away by the wind, drifts sideways along with the sword toward the cardboard box pile by the roadside.

Sound effects: low truck horn, fierce side wind.

The moment the truck passes, the grand xianxia music stops immediately.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

[00:10-00:12]

【Shot 4: The fairy falls into the mortal world】

Quick cut to a front-facing shot of the cardboard box pile.

Sword Immortal Sister crashes headfirst into the discarded cardboard boxes in an exaggerated but safe pose.

The boxes instantly burst outward in all directions.

A large box covers her upper body, and two smaller boxes slowly land on her head and shoulders.

The silver longsword spins out of control in the air twice, all sword energy completely disappears, then it falls beside her like an ordinary metal plate.

“Clang!”

The scene suddenly becomes completely silent.

Only the slow rolling of cardboard boxes remains, along with a lonely crow cawing in the distance.

━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

【Performance Focus】

In the first half, Sword Immortal Sister must be extremely aloof, elegant, and confident, with the oppressive presence of a true xianxia master.

When hit by the side wind, her expression must clearly go through four stages:

proud → confused → terrified → blank

In the first half, the bicycle girl must be genuinely admiring; after seeing Sword Immortal Sister fall, she should first freeze in shock, and only then try hard to suppress laughter.

The bicycle girl must not appear mocking or gleeful from the start.

【Shot Rhythm】

The first three seconds should quickly establish a blockbuster xianxia feel.

After the bicycle girl’s compliment, hold Sword Immortal Sister’s facial reaction for at least about one second so the audience can clearly see her secretly feeling smug.

Before the truck appears, there must be no advance hint through sound, shadows, camera movement, or character gaze.

After the truck passes, cut off the xianxia music immediately and use sudden silence to heighten the comedic contrast.

After the final line of dialogue, freeze immediately; do not drag it out or add extra plot.

【Avoid】

Do not let the blue truck hit any character, bicycle, or the longsword.

Do not show serious traffic accidents, injuries, blood, pain, or dangerous realistic imagery.

Do not change the character’s face, hairstyle, clothing, body type, or identity traits.

Do not turn the silver longsword into a skateboard, broom, surfboard, or any other object.

Do not show clipping, limb distortion, abnormal fingers, extra hands or feet, or reversed joints.

Do not let characters or props teleport within the same shot.

Do not use anime character textures, game CG textures, plastic skin, or obvious AI fake faces.

Do not shoot the twist like a disaster film or thriller.

Do not add explosions, rollovers, collisions, rear-end crashes, or crowd panic.

Keep the overall tone safe, light, absurd, and harmless as a comedy twist.
